description.short_caption: Axial chest CT scan showing bilateral pulmonary abnormalities.
description.detailed_description: This axial chest CT scan demonstrates bilateral pulmonary abnormalities, including patchy areas of ground-glass opacities and nodular consolidations. The abnormalities are distributed in both lungs, with some involvement of the periphery. The mediastinum and central airways appear unremarkable. The scan is presented in a lung window setting, enhancing the visibility of parenchymal changes.

description.short_caption: Histopathology of a resected lung nodule showing central necrosis and fibrotic encapsulation.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image shows a cross-section of a lung nodule with a central area of necrosis surrounded by a fibrotic capsule. The necrotic center appears eosinophilic and amorphous, while the surrounding tissue demonstrates a fibrotic reaction with cellular infiltrates. The periphery of the image shows adjacent lung parenchyma. The staining technique appears to be hematoxylin and eosin (H&E).
